name: Sfillian Crumb
tools: Viol, pan flute, lute, disguise kit, forgery kit
saveNotes: Fey Ancestry: advantage on saves against being charmed; magic can't put you to sleep.

spells.name: Eidolic Chains
spells.text: A creature that you can see within range must succeed on a Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check (its choice) against your spell save DC or become Grappled. It can repeat the check at the start of each of its turns to break free.

spells.name: Thunderous Chord
spells.text: A blast of sound heard up to 60 feet away. A creature you can see within range makes a Constitution saving throw or takes 2d4 Thunder damage and is Deafened until the end of its next turn. The damage increases to 4d4 at 5th level, 6d4 at 11th and 8d4 at 17th.

spells.name: Vicious Mockery
spells.text:
You unleash a string of insults laced with subtle enchantments at one creature you can see or hear within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or take 1d6 Psychic damage and have Disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn.

Cantrip Upgrade. The damage increases by 1d6 when you reach levels 5 (2d6), 11 (3d6), and 17 (4d6).

spells.name: Charm Person
spells.text:
One Humanoid you can see within range makes a Wisdom saving throw. It does so with Advantage if you or your allies are fighting it. On a failed save, the target has the Charmed condition until the spell ends or until you or your allies damage it. The Charmed creature is Friendly to you. When the spell ends, the target knows it was Charmed by you.

Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 1.

spells.name: Disguise Self
spells.text:
You make yourself—including your clothing, armor, weapons, and other belongings on your person—look different until the spell ends. You can seem 1 foot shorter or taller and can appear heavier or lighter. You must adopt a form that has the same basic arrangement of limbs as you have. Otherwise, the extent of the illusion is up to you.

The changes wrought by this spell fail to hold up to physical inspection. For example, if you use this spell to add a hat to your outfit, objects pass through the hat, and anyone who touches it would feel nothing.

To discern that you are disguised, a creature must take the Study action to inspect your appearance and succeed on an check against your spell save DC.

spells.name: Loki’s Gift
spells.text: Even the most barefaced lie seems plausible: you have advantage on Charisma (Deception) checks for whatever you're currently saying. If the check fails, the creature knows you tried to manipulate it with magic. Lie to a Friendly creature and if it fails a Charisma save it may reveal an embarrassing secret.

spells.name: Sleep
spells.material: a pinch of sand or rose petals
spells.text:
Each creature of your choice in a 5-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point within range must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the Incapacitated condition until the end of its next turn, at which point it must repeat the save. If the target fails the second save, the target has the Unconscious condition for the duration. The spell ends on a target if it takes damage or someone within 5 feet of it takes an action to shake it out of the spell's effect.

Creatures that don't sleep, such as elves, or that have Immunity to the Exhaustion condition automatically succeed on saves against this spell.

spells.name: Hideous Laughter
spells.text:
One creature of your choice that you can see within range makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it has the Prone and Incapacitated conditions for the duration. During that time, it laughs uncontrollably if it's capable of laughter, and it can't end the Prone condition on itself.

At the end of each of its turns and each time it takes damage, it makes another Ability saving throw saving throw. The target has Advantage on the save if the save is triggered by damage. On a successful save, the spell ends.

Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level about 1.

spells.name: Time Step
spells.text: You briefly step forward in time: you disappear and reappear at the start of your next turn within 30 feet of where you vanished. Nothing can affect you in between, and you aren't aware of what happens meanwhile.

spells.name: Major Image
spells.text:
You create the image of an object, a creature, or some other visible phenomenon that is no larger than a 20-foot Cube. The image appears at a spot that you can see within range and lasts for the duration. It seems real, including sounds, smells, and temperature appropriate to the thing depicted, but it can't deal damage or cause conditions.

If you are within range of the illusion, you can take a Magic action to cause the image to move to any other spot within range. As the image changes location, you can alter its appearance so that its movements appear natural for the image. For example, if you create an image of a creature and move it, you can alter the image so that it appears to be walking. Similarly, you can cause the illusion to make different sounds at different times, even making it carry on a conversation, for example.

Physical interaction with the image reveals it to be an illusion, for things can pass through it. A creature that takes a Study action to examine the image can determine that it is an illusion with a successful check against your spell save DC. If a creature discerns the illusion for what it is, the creature can see through the image, and its other sensory qualities become faint to the creature.

Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The spell lasts until dispelled, without requiring Concentration, if cast with a level 4+ spell slot.

spells.name: Sending
spells.text:
You send a short message of 25 words or fewer to a creature you have met or a creature described to you by someone who has met it. The target hears the message in its mind, recognizes you as the sender if it knows you, and can answer in a like manner immediately. The spell enables targets to understand the meaning of your message.

You can send the message across any distance and even to other planes of existence, but if the target is on a different plane than you, there is a 5 percent chance that the message doesn't arrive. You know if the delivery fails.

Upon receiving your message, a creature can block your ability to reach it again with this spell for 8 hours. If you try to send another message during that time, you learn that you are blocked, and the spell fails.

spells.name: Stinking Cloud
spells.text:
You create a 20-foot-radius Sphere of yellow, nauseating gas centered on a point within range. The cloud is Heavilyobscured. The cloud lingers in the air for the duration or until a strong wind (such as the one created by Gust of Wind) disperses it.

Each creature that starts its turn in the Sphere must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or have the Poisoned condition until the end of the current turn. While Poisoned in this way, the creature can't take an action or a Bonus Action.

spells.name: Hallucinatory Terrain
spells.text:
You make natural terrain in a 150-foot Cube in range look, sound, and smell like another sort of natural terrain. Thus, open fields or a road can be made to resemble a swamp, hill, crevasse, or some other difficult or impassable terrain. A pond can be made to seem like a grassy meadow, a precipice like a gentle slope, or a rock-strewn gully like a wide and smooth road. Manufactured structures, equipment, and creatures within the area aren't changed.

The tactile characteristics of the terrain are unchanged, so creatures entering the area are likely to notice the illusion. If the difference isn't obvious by touch, a creature examining the illusion can take the Study action to make an check against your spell save DC to disbelieve it. If a creature discerns that the terrain is illusory, the creature sees a vague image superimposed on the real terrain.

actions.name: Rapier
actions.text: Melee weapon attack (finesse), reach 5 ft. Hit: 1d8 + Dex Piercing.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.text: Melee or thrown (20/60 ft), finesse. Hit: 1d4 + Dex Piercing.

actions.name: Bardic Inspiration
actions.text: Target a creature other than you within 60 ft that can hear you. Within 10 minutes it can add a d8 to one ability check, attack roll or saving throw.

actions.name: Guiding Tone (Fermata)
actions.text: Expend a Bardic Inspiration die; a creature other than you within 60 ft makes a Wisdom save against your spell DC or takes Psychic damage equal to half the die and is pushed 10 ft in a direction you choose. It can fail on purpose.

actions.name: Crash (Marcato)
actions.text: When a creature other than you within 60 ft hits with an attack, expend a Bardic Inspiration die. The target of that attack makes a Strength save against your spell DC or takes Thunder damage equal to half the die and is knocked Prone. Target the creature that was hit.

actions.name: Dissonance (Discordia)
actions.text: When a creature within 60 ft makes a saving throw, expend a Bardic Inspiration die and reduce its save by half the number rolled (after the roll, before the DM says whether it succeeds).

actions.name: Countercharm
actions.text: Until the end of your next turn, you and friendly creatures within 30 ft have advantage on saves against being Frightened or Charmed.

actions.name: Frenetic Crescendo
actions.text: Expend any number of Bardic Inspiration uses; for each, give a Bardic Inspiration die to a different creature within 60 ft you can see (one die per creature).

features.name: Bardic Inspiration (d8)
features.text: 7 uses (Charisma + 2 from Battle Muse), regained on a short or long rest (Font of Inspiration).

features.name: Jack of All Trades
features.text: Half proficiency (+1) on ability checks you aren't proficient in, initiative included.

features.name: Song of Rest
features.text: Allies who hear you perform during a short rest regain an extra 1d6 HP when they spend Hit Dice.

features.name: Battle Muse
features.text: Two extra uses of Bardic Inspiration (included).

features.name: Symphony of Conflict
features.text: Maestro techniques need a free hand, baton or wand; you must see the target and it must hear you. Crash, Dissonance and Guiding Tone are in Actions.

features.name: Fey Ancestry
features.text: Advantage on saves against being charmed; magic can't put you to sleep.

features.name: False Identity
features.text: A second identity with documents and disguises; you can forge documents you've seen examples of.

inventory: Entertainer's pack (bedroll, 2 costumes, 5 candles, rations, waterskin, disguise kit)
A candle that can't be lit
token: Sfillian Crumb, a young half-elf bard and charlatan: pale skin, sharp features, brown eyes, untidy black hair, a sly lopsided grin, a flamboyant patchwork jacket stitched with faintly glowing thread, a lute slung across his back and a rapier at his hip, one hand raised mid-flourish like a conductor. Sardonic and theatrical.
flags: Level: the file is named Lvl 8, but the sheet inside says Bard 7 (23,000 XP, spell slots 4/3/3/1, 32 HP). I built him as level 7; send an updated sheet if he's 8.

Spells use the 2024 rules text where the table has them (Vicious Mockery 1d6, Sleep makes targets Incapacitated then Unconscious). Eidolic Chains, Thunderous Chord, Loki’s Gift and Time Step are written from the sheet.
Maestro techniques that deal half a Bardic Inspiration die roll the d8 and halve it automatically.
